taxonomy.label: Data & records
taxonomy.definition: Returns a record or dataset about the world: market prices, weather, filings, on-chain state, profiles, enrichment, or extracted page content.

taxonomy.label: Search & discovery
taxonomy.definition: Takes a query and returns matches or a shortlist: web, social, scholarly, regulatory, or keyword search.

taxonomy.label: Model inference
taxonomy.definition: Runs a model to generate or score content: chat, messages, image generation, AI answers, AI verdicts, reranking, or similarity.

taxonomy.label: Payments & checkout
taxonomy.definition: Moves value or returns payment execution, quote, or receipt data.

taxonomy.label: Infrastructure & security
taxonomy.definition: Operational and security primitives: status, time, DNS, dependency checks, URL safety, screening, and redaction.

taxonomy.label: Other
taxonomy.definition: Does not fit the five above: a novelty endpoint and an agent messaging network in this census.
